text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Live was a tremendous success! 
Umamusume and fans poured their hearts out 
to one another, spending an irreplaceable 
moment together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved her long-awaited dream of 
reviving the Grand Live, Light Hello 
enjoyed the moment from the wings, gently 
watching over the Umamusume on stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Backstage, the high-fives of girls 
celebrating their success ring out. They 
dash forward— toward the fans waiting for 
them.
